component.name: ADA
component.summary: Encrypted chat client for your local Ollama server

description.p: ADA is a small, native chat app for your own Ollama server. Chats and a persistent memory are stored in one database that is encrypted with SQLCipher. You enter the passphrase at every start, and it is never saved.

ul.li: Chats with live streaming answers and a stop button
A memory that carries notes about you across all chats; you can read and edit it at any time
Optional web search through your own SearXNG server
Automatic detection of Ollama and SearXNG on this computer

description.p: ADA is experimental and has not been audited. If you forget the passphrase, your data cannot be recovered. Model answers are shown as plain text. ADA needs a running Ollama server; it does not include one.
